header.subject: English
header.title: Memory Lane & Chat Time with Sir Riaz
header.goal: Children listen to a joke or fact, choose how they feel, and say why: “I feel ___ because ___.”

card.bring: textbook p.123 · chalk · children's books and pencils

moves.do: Ask: what do you remember about wild animals? Take three answers.
moves.how: Expect: “Wonders of the Wild.” Class echoes it.

moves.do: Open p.123. Point to Sir Riaz and his four speech bubbles.
moves.how: Say each key word with an action; children copy.
moves.say: “Today we listen to Sir Riaz's jokes and facts and say how we feel.”

moves.do: Model it once: read the tree joke, point to 😄, say why.
moves.how: Show good listening: face the speaker, repeat the reason.
moves.say: “I feel happy because the tree says ‘Leaf me alone!’”
moves.think: A tree talking is funny. It makes me smile, so my face is 😄. My reason is the joke: ‘Leaf me alone!’

moves.do: Read the plants fact. The whole class finishes your sentence.
moves.how: Then ask: where do you see plants at home? Take three answers in full sentences.
moves.say: “I feel surprised because …” → class: “… plants give us air!”

moves.do: Window side says a reason; other points to its bubble and feeling.
moves.how: Ayesha and Bilal show it first. A checks p.123. Two pairs share aloud.

turn.a: Because snow leopards can jump really far.
turn.b: This bubble. (points) You feel surprised because they jump far.
turn.help: Point to the bubble; say “You feel …”.

moves.do: Everyone writes alone: draw each face, write one because word.
moves.how: 1. snow leopards · 2. tree joke. Done? 3. Write the whole sentence for the waves joke.
moves.say: “Draw how you feel. Write one word: why?”

sections.mistake: Draws a face, no reason. Ask: “What did Sir Riaz say?” The child points to the word in the bubble and copies it.
sections.stuck: Point to one face on the board; the child names it, then copies because + one word.

moves.do: Alone: write one sentence in the book. 👍
moves.how: Each child shows the face alone; five children each say why aloud: “I feel ___ because ___.”

sections.correct: a face + a reason from the fact (“… because bees make honey”).
sections.success: I can say how I feel and give one reason.
sections.ask: Which part of the fact made you feel that way?
sections.listen: The detail: bees visit flowers and make honey. Any reason from the fact.

moves.do: Tell a family member one joke or fact from p.123

pictures.title: THE BOARD BY THE END · How do you feel?

expect.html:
GRADE 2 · ENGLISH · Ch.10 Wonders of the WildDay 1 · 40 min

Memory Lane & Chat Time with Sir Riaz

Children listen to a joke or fact, choose how they feel, and say why: “I feel ___ because ___.”
Bringtextbook p.123 · chalk · children's books and pencils Wordswind · breathe · waves · snow leopards
PRACTICE · 24 of 40 min
5′ 7′ 12′ 12′ 4′
OpenExplainWe DoYou Do✓
★ Your one thing today · in move

Opening

0–5′Full details ›
1

Ask: what do you remember about wild animals? Take three answers. Expect: “Wonders of the Wild.” Class echoes it. “I remember …” → class repeats it.

2

Open p.123. Point to Sir Riaz and his four speech bubbles. Say each key word with an action; children copy. “Today we listen to Sir Riaz's jokes and facts and say how we feel.”

Explanation · I Do

5–12′Full details ›
3

Model it once: read the tree joke, point to 😄, say why. Show good listening: face the speaker, repeat the reason. “I feel happy because the tree says ‘Leaf me alone!’”Think aloud: “A tree talking is funny. It makes me smile, so my face is 😄. My reason is the joke: ‘Leaf me alone!’”

We Do

12–24′Full details ›
4

I START, YOU FINISH
Read the plants fact. The whole class finishes your sentence. Then ask: where do you see plants at home? Take three answers in full sentences. “I feel surprised because …” → class: “… plants give us air!”

5

ONE NEIGHBOUR TURN
Window side says a reason; other points to its bubble and feeling. Ayesha and Bilal show it first. A checks p.123. Two pairs share aloud. “You feel ___ because ___.”Window side first: “Because snow leopards can jump really far.” → Reply: “This bubble. (points) You feel surprised because they jump far.” · Stop: one clap, eyes on me · Stuck? Point to the bubble; say “You feel …”.

You Do · in the book

24–36′Full details ›
6

⏱ 24′ stop explaining
Everyone writes alone: draw each face, write one because word. 1. snow leopards · 2. tree joke. Done? 3. Write the whole sentence for the waves joke. “Draw how you feel. Write one word: why?”If stuck: Point to one face on the board; the child names it, then copies because + one word.

Check 5 books · answers

1. Snow leopards jump far →😮 jump / far
2. Tree joke →😄 leaf
3. Waves joke →“I feel ___ because the waves …”

Likely mistake

Draws a face, no reason. Ask: “What did Sir Riaz say?” The child points to the word in the bubble and copies it.

THE BOARD BY THE END · How do you feel?

😄happy
🙁sad
😴sleepy
😮surprised
I feel ___ because ___.

Check · exit ticket

36–40′Full details ›
7

Alone: write one sentence in the book. 👍 Each child shows the face alone; five children each say why aloud: “I feel ___ because ___.” Is it right?Ask: “Which part of the fact made you feel that way?” → Listen for: The detail: bees visit flowers and make honey. Any reason from the fact.Success: “I can say how I feel and give one reason.” 👍 or ✊ firstCorrect: a face + a reason from the fact (“… because bees make honey”).

Homework

at homeFull details ›
8

Tell a family member one joke or fact from p.123 and say “I feel ___ because ___.”

Full lesson plan ›
gates: exit ticket: no written work (children answer aloud or with a thumb)
exit ticket: thumbs up/down need a statement to judge, not a question (say ends with . or ۔)
